newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SCA SEES STRONG TRENDS FOR SAWN TIMBER.
newsitem.headline: SCA SEES STRONG TRENDS FOR SAWN TIMBER.

text.p: Swedish forestry group SCA said on Thursday that rising prices for sawn timber would probably continue for a while although a temporary setback could occur.
"It seems too soon to say that the strong trends are over," SCA's chief executive Sverker Martin-Lof told an analyst meeting.
"I think a setback might come but it is too early to count out the good prices."
Spruce prices are close to peaking while pine prices might rise somewhat more, he said.
"The price pressure has virtually ceased and a programme for price hikes is on its way in Europe," Martin-Lof said.
